body: Continue the existing Design 2.0 Candidate 01 Page 2 motion work. Left-side large-image/four-small-image geometry is already precise and MUST remain unchanged. Fix ONLY the right side. The current regression comes from forcing both previews through one averaged halfW/master rectangle. Derive the right large preview directly from the actual bounding box of right-side source cards [2,3,6,7]. The right preview left/top/width/height must equal that real four-card bounding box relative to .products__preview. Its image container and mask must inherit exactly 100% of that rectangle. Do not alter Candidate 01 content, 4W grouping, Page 3, or the left-side geometry. Preserve the current Page 2 animation timing unless a geometry-dependent correction is necessary. After patching, run syntax validation and show the diff. Do not claim visual acceptance without browser evidence.
related_goal: Doré Design 2.0 — Candidate 01 Page 2 exact four-pane assembly

metadata.acceptance: right large preview matches real bounding box of cards 2,3,6,7; left unchanged; Python compiles; diff limited to PAGE2_ASSEMBLY_FIX
